objective: Diagnose whether the ordinary AdamW update conflicts with absolute-relevance or continuous-pairwise source objectives, and authorize a constrained update only if the diagnosis is positive.

stage_i.name: gradient_conflict_audit
stage_i.parameter_subset_identity: canonical SHA-256 of ordered name, shape, numel, and dtype records
evidence_per_step: ordinary AdamW candidate dot each protected gradient
stage_i.adamw_candidate_definition: descent displacement u0 = theta_before - theta_after for the ordinary AdamW step, including moment advancement and decoupled weight decay
stage_i.conflict_definition: g_absolute dot u0 < -1e-12 or g_pairwise dot u0 < -1e-12

stage_ii_trigger.rule: strict majority of audited steps have an ordinary AdamW candidate conflict

stage_ii.authorization: forbidden unless a frozen, hash-bound Stage-I result passes the preregistered trigger
stage_ii.optimization: minimize ||u-u0||^2 subject to g_absolute dot u >= 0 and g_pairwise dot u >= 0
stage_ii.solver: deterministic two-constraint active-set projection with primal, dual, stationarity, and complementarity audit
stage_ii.adamw_semantics: advance ordinary AdamW moments and decoupled weight-decay candidate first; project only the candidate parameter displacement; retain the advanced moments
stage_ii.gradient_clipping: same fixed global combined-gradient clipping as V2.1B before constructing u0
